mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that depresses corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE >= 10.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in industrial production indicate a deepening economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, rising housing starts (HOUST) reflect improving consumer confidence and construction activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months during post-recession recovery when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls to 0.5% or below, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and persistently low FEDFUNDS indicate rising inflationary pressures without accommodative policy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is low, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases, a quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
